chapter.subject: Social Science
chapter.chapter_title: The Gupta Era: An Age of Tireless Creativity
source_key_points: 7 CHAPTER The Gupta Era: An Age of Tireless Creativity Neither force nor mere diplomacy can eliminate evil; nor is righteousness upheld by flattery alone.
It is wisdom and knowledge that truly strengthen a kingdom — not indulgence in luxuries.
Landscape of Ajanta caves, dating from the 2nd century BCE to about 480 CE 7 – The Gupta Era: An Age of Tireless Creativity The Big 1.
Why is the Gupta period sometimes Questions called the ‘classical age’ in Indian history?
What was happening in the rest of the subcontinent at this time?
Who were some great figures of this period, and why do their stories matter today?
145 Reprint 2026-27 Chapter 7.indd 145 08-04-2025 11:41:36 Dhruv and Bhavisha had just returned from their journey to the Pānḍya kingdom.
They had seen the splendid markets, taken a short trip on a ship, and met some Roman traders buying pearls.
Now they were itching to use Itihāsa again and jump a few centuries.
What about the people and society — would they have changed?
